subject: [PATCH v3 09/12] mm/collapse: open-code collapse_single_pmd() in its two callers

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch removes the function collapse_single_pmd() and instead open-codes its functionality in two callers, khugepaged's lock_dropped and madvise_collapse(). The original function had a complex locking contract that is simplified by having each caller drop and reacquire the necessary locks. This change does not introduce any functional changes but rather simplifies the code and improves maintainability.
